about: Evani.Dev genre catalog. Rank and reach_index are estimates of how much each genre is played (2025 data). Reference games describe mechanics only; all content must be original.

genres.name: User-generated game platform
systems: In-game level editor with snapping and props
genres.image_scene: Polished blocky avatars run a player-made obstacle course in the sky, a creator placing a prop with a build gizmo, a portal hub to other worlds. HUD: player list, chat, play and publish buttons.

genres.name: Voxel sandbox
systems: Chunked block world with procedural terrain
genres.image_scene: A block-built world at sunset with a cliffside house, a mine shaft and a block-placement outline. HUD: hotbar, health and hunger icons.

genres.name: Battle royale
systems: 50 to 100 player interest management on the server
genres.image_scene: A player sprints toward a hilltop as a glowing storm wall closes in, other players gliding down in the distance and a loot crate glowing nearby. HUD: players-left counter, zone timer, minimap, inventory hotbar.

genres.name: MOBA
genres.image_scene: A lane fight between heroes with flashy abilities near a stone tower, minion waves clashing and jungle on both sides. HUD: ability bar with cooldowns, item slots, minimap, kill score.

genres.name: Match-3
systems: Board generation with no starting matches
genres.image_scene: A glossy grid of candy-like jewels with a colour bomb exploding into cascades and sparkles, a cute mascot beside the board. HUD: moves left, goal icons, star bar.

genres.name: Military FPS
systems: Ballistics with bullet drop and travel time
genres.image_scene: First-person view from a squad advancing through a war-torn city street, a tank rolling past, debris and dust, tracer fire overhead. HUD: compass, squad markers, ammo, objective marker.

genres.name: Tactical FPS
systems: Hitscan weapons with recoil patterns and movement spread
Round and economy system with buy menu
genres.image_scene: First-person view down an assault rifle at a sun-bleached Mediterranean bomb site, a teammate holding an angle, a smoke grenade drifting across a doorway. HUD: health and armour, ammo, round timer, team scores, minimap.

genres.name: Football (soccer)
genres.image_scene: Broadcast camera view of a night match in a packed stadium, a striker shooting from the edge of the box under floodlights. HUD: score and match clock, player name, radar map.

genres.name: Block puzzle
systems: Rotation with wall kicks where pieces fall
genres.image_scene: A wooden block grid nearly full, a row clearing with a flash, three pieces waiting in the tray below. HUD: score, best score, combo text.

genres.name: Open-world crime sandbox
systems: On-foot and vehicle enter and exit
genres.image_scene: A getaway car drifts through a sunny coastal city intersection with police cars in pursuit, pedestrians scattering under palm trees. HUD: minimap with wanted stars, cash.

genres.name: Mobile base-builder strategy
systems: Base layout with build timers and upgrade queues
genres.image_scene: A walled village base with defensive towers and builders upgrading a town hall under a timer bubble, troops in a training camp. HUD: gold and crystal resources, shop and attack buttons, builder count.

genres.name: Card and solitaire
genres.image_scene: A green felt table with a solitaire layout, cards cascading under warm lamp light. HUD: moves, time, score, undo.

genres.name: One-tap casual
genres.image_scene: A tiny paper plane glides between hanging lanterns in a sunset sky. HUD: one big score number.

genres.name: Monster collector
genres.image_scene: A young trainer in tall grass meets a wild fire-tailed creature, a capture orb in hand, a small town and windmill behind. HUD: party icons and an encounter prompt.

genres.name: Word game
systems: Letter wheel, tile rack or guess grid
genres.image_scene: A crossword grid partly filled above a circular letter wheel, a word being swiped, a scenic landscape behind. HUD: level, coins, hint button.

genres.name: Open-world RPG
genres.image_scene: A hooded adventurer with a spell glowing in one hand and a sword in the other watches a dragon fly over snowy mountains above a stone village. HUD: health, magic and stamina bars, compass with quest markers.

genres.name: Digital board game
genres.image_scene: A polished wooden board-game table with tokens, dice mid-roll and player cards under warm lighting. HUD: player turn indicator and scores.

genres.name: Hero shooter
systems: Heroes with cooldown abilities and ultimates
genres.image_scene: A hero with a glowing arm cannon on a colourful futuristic city payload map, allies firing bright abilities, an ultimate charging. HUD: ability icons with cooldowns, ultimate percentage, objective progress.

genres.name: Kart racer
systems: Arcade kart physics with drift-charge boosts
Item boxes with position-weighted item odds
AI racers on racing-line splines with rubber-banding
genres.image_scene: A go-kart drifts around a candy-coloured mountain track throwing blue drift sparks, rivals dodging bouncing item bombs, floating item boxes ahead. HUD: race position, lap counter, item slot, minimap.

genres.name: Life sim
genres.image_scene: A cutaway two-storey house where characters cook, chat and garden, thought bubbles above them. HUD: needs bars, mood and a build-mode button.

genres.name: Basketball
genres.image_scene: Broadcast view of an arena game, a player rising for a dunk with defenders reaching, sweat and light flares. HUD: score bug, shot clock, shot meter.

genres.name: Endless runner
systems: Auto-run controller with lanes or jumps
Procedural chunk spawner with a difficulty curve
genres.image_scene: A skateboarding kid dashes down a three-lane city track between trains and barriers, a line of coins and a jump ramp ahead. HUD: score, coin count and power-up timer.

genres.name: Open-world adventure
reference_games_mechanics_only: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
systems: Systemic physics, fire and weather interactions
genres.image_scene: A lone traveller paraglides off a cliff over a vast valley of forests, ruins and a distant volcano, a shrine light glowing far away. Minimal HUD: stamina wheel and compass.

genres.name: Survival crafting
genres.image_scene: A survivor in furs sits at a campfire beside a half-built log cabin in a misty northern forest, wolf eyes glinting in the dark. HUD: health, stamina, hunger, crafting hotbar.

genres.name: Farming sim
systems: Crops on a tile grid with growth days
genres.image_scene: A cozy farm with crop rows, a farmer watering, chickens wandering, a barn and an autumn tree. HUD: date and time, energy bar, tool hotbar, money.

genres.name: Arcade racer
genres.image_scene: A supercar drifts along a sunset coastal highway through traffic, tyre smoke trailing, cliffs and ocean beside the road. HUD: speedometer, nitro gauge, position, minimap.

genres.name: Merge puzzle
genres.image_scene: A merge board of items combining into higher tiers, an order board above with characters waiting. HUD: energy counter, coins, event timer.

genres.name: Car soccer
systems: Car physics with jump and boost
genres.image_scene: Rocket-boosted cars leap to strike a giant ball in a futuristic arena, boost trails behind them and a goal explosion on the far side. HUD: score, clock, boost meter.

genres.name: Turn-based JRPG
genres.image_scene: Battle screen with a party of four heroes facing a giant crystal golem in a cavern, a spell effect bursting. HUD: command menu (Attack, Magic, Item), HP and MP bars, turn order.

genres.name: MMORPG lite
systems: Authoritative server with zones and interest management
genres.image_scene: A raid party of adventurers fights a giant dragon in a lava cave, spell effects everywhere and names floating above the players. HUD: action bars, party frames, chat window, target frame.

genres.name: Table sports
genres.image_scene: A felt pool table mid-break with balls scattering, a cue aim line and ghost ball. HUD: player turn, ball group, shot power.

genres.name: Number and grid logic
genres.image_scene: A clean number-puzzle grid with pencil marks and a highlighted row on a calm paper background. HUD: timer, mistakes, number pad.

genres.name: Party minigames
genres.image_scene: Four bean-shaped party characters race across a giant obstacle course of swinging hammers and slime, confetti in the air. HUD: player placings and round timer.

genres.name: Idle and incremental
genres.image_scene: A stylised gold mine with automated carts, drills and upgrade buttons, huge numbers floating upward. HUD: currency in big numbers, upgrade and prestige buttons.

genres.name: Digital card game
systems: Rules engine with triggers and a resolution stack
genres.image_scene: A fantasy card table with two heroes' portraits, minions on the board and a spell card being played with a burst of light. HUD: mana counter, hand of cards, end-turn button.

genres.name: 2D platformer
systems: Kinematic character controller with coyote time, jump buffering and variable jump height
Tile collision with slopes and one-way platforms
genres.image_scene: A small fox-eared hero in a teal scarf leaps between floating grassy platforms over a gap, a trail of gold coins arcing overhead, a shelled beetle patrolling below and a hilltop castle on the horizon. HUD: lives, coin count and timer across the top.

genres.name: Loot action RPG
systems: Procedural loot with affixes and rarity
genres.image_scene: A hero in heavy armour fights a horde of undead in a torch-lit crypt, loot dropping with coloured rarity beams. HUD: health and mana orbs, skill hotbar, minimap.

genres.name: Extraction shooter
genres.image_scene: A scavenger crouches over a loot container in a dusty abandoned facility, a hostile silhouette at the end of the corridor, flashlight beam cutting the dust. Minimal HUD: raid timer and extraction marker.

genres.name: Cooking and time management
genres.image_scene: A chaotic kitchen with four chefs chopping, frying and plating, order tickets with timers above the stations. HUD: order tickets, score, round timer.

genres.name: Soulslike
genres.image_scene: A battered knight with a greatshield faces a towering antlered beast in a fog-filled cathedral ruin, embers drifting, lock-on reticle on the boss. HUD: health and stamina bars top-left, boss health bar at the bottom.

genres.name: Platform fighter
systems: Dynamic camera that frames every fighter
genres.image_scene: Four chunky original fighters brawl on a floating stage above the clouds, one flying off-screen with a knockback trail, an item crate dropping in. HUD: damage percentages and stock icons along the bottom.

genres.name: Driving and truck sim
genres.image_scene: Cockpit view from a truck cab on a highway at dawn, the trailer in the side mirror and a navigation screen on the dash. HUD: speed limit, route, delivery timer.

genres.name: Tower defense
genres.image_scene: A winding forest path lined with archer, mage and cannon towers firing at a wave of goblins and ogres. HUD: lives, gold, wave counter, tower build menu.

genres.name: Virtual pet
systems: Needs that decay in real time
genres.image_scene: A fluffy round pet creature happily eating in a cozy room, a toy ball nearby. HUD: hunger, happiness and energy icons, care action buttons.

genres.name: 3D action-adventure
reference_games_mechanics_only: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
genres.image_scene: A hero on horseback crosses a sunlit field toward a mountain temple, a glowing spirit companion nearby and a distant castle. HUD: hearts, context action button, item slots.

genres.name: Tank combat
genres.image_scene: A mid-century style tank on a hill aims its turret across a ruined village at a spotted enemy tank outline. HUD: crosshair with penetration indicator, reload timer, minimap.

genres.name: Bubble shooter
genres.image_scene: A colourful ceiling of bubbles with a launcher at the bottom aiming a bank shot as a cluster pops. HUD: score, shots left, next bubble.

genres.name: Auto battler
genres.image_scene: A hex board where two armies of chess-piece-like heroes fight automatically, synergy glows on the units, a bench of spare units below. HUD: shop with five unit cards, gold, level, trait list.

genres.name: 4X strategy
genres.image_scene: A hex map with a growing city, units on hills and rivers, borders in team colours and a rival capital in the distance. HUD: tech progress, turn counter, resource yields, end-turn button.

genres.name: Physics puzzle
genres.image_scene: A slingshot launches a round armadillo critter at a wobbly tower of planks and ice guarded by smug raccoons. HUD: score, stars, critters remaining.

genres.name: Tap rhythm
genres.image_scene: Falling piano-style tiles synced to music, a hit burst with the word Perfect, a glowing background. HUD: score, combo, accuracy.

genres.name: Team sports sim
genres.image_scene: Broadcast view of an American football snap in a packed stadium, linemen engaging, the quarterback dropping back with receivers' routes drawn. HUD: score, down and distance, play clock.

genres.name: Survival horror
genres.image_scene: An investigator in a dark mansion corridor aims a flashlight at a shambling creature, peeling wallpaper and flickering lights. HUD: ammo count and condition indicator only.

genres.name: 2D sandbox
genres.image_scene: A cross-section world of caverns and ore veins, a cozy hilltop house and a player mining with a pickaxe while a giant moth boss approaches. HUD: hearts, mana stars, inventory hotbar.

genres.name: Visual novel
genres.image_scene: Two characters talk on a school rooftop at sunset, a dialogue box with a name tag at the bottom and two choice buttons.

genres.name: Action roguelite
genres.image_scene: A hero dashes through a fiery underworld chamber, upgrade boons glowing, enemies closing in, an exit door marked with a reward icon. HUD: health, boon icons, currency.

genres.name: Survivors-like
systems: Thousands of enemies through a spatial hash
genres.image_scene: A lone character stands in a moonlit field surrounded by hundreds of creeping monsters, orbiting blades and a damaging aura around them, XP gems scattered everywhere. HUD: XP bar, timer, kill count, weapon icons.

genres.name: Physics driving
systems: Two-wheel or four-wheel physics with rider lean
genres.image_scene: A rickety jeep climbs a steep hilly road strewn with fuel cans and coins, the driver's head wobbling on bouncy suspension. HUD: fuel gauge, distance, coins.

genres.name: Social deduction
genres.image_scene: A spaceship deck with colourful crew characters doing tasks, one suspicious crewmate near a vent and a red sabotage alarm light. HUD: task bar, map, report button.

genres.name: Deckbuilder roguelike
genres.image_scene: A hand of five illustrated cards fanned at the bottom, a hooded hero on the left facing two masked cultists showing their attack intents. HUD: energy orb, draw and discard piles, relic bar, health.

genres.name: City builder
genres.image_scene: A dense modern city with highways, zoned districts, parks and a river, traffic flowing. HUD: budget, population, demand bars, tool toolbar.

genres.name: Isometric CRPG
genres.image_scene: A party of four adventurers fights in a tavern courtyard, fire spreading across spilled oil, dice-roll popups above combatants. HUD: party portraits, action bar, turn order.

genres.name: 2D fighting
genres.image_scene: Two original martial artists face off on a rain-soaked rooftop at dusk, one launching a glowing energy projectile, hit spark on impact. HUD: mirrored health bars, round timer, super meters along the bottom.

genres.name: Escape room and hidden object
genres.image_scene: Close-up of an ornate puzzle box with rotating rings and hidden drawers on a lamp-lit desk. HUD: inventory slots and hint button.

genres.name: Golf and mini golf
systems: Ball physics with wind and slope
genres.image_scene: A golfer lines up a shot on a seaside fairway, flags bending in the wind, an aiming arc and landing ring on the green. HUD: wind, club, distance, power meter.

genres.name: .io multiplayer
genres.image_scene: A huge arena of colourful glowing blobs of different sizes, the player's blob eating pellets. HUD: leaderboard, mass, minimap.

genres.name: 3D platformer
systems: 3D character controller with long jump, wall jump and ground pound
Orbit camera with collision and auto-framing
Drop shadow under the player for depth
genres.image_scene: A round-bodied explorer mid-jump between spinning platforms on a floating island hub, glowing collectible stars on ledges, a waterfall and windmill below, a soft shadow under the character. HUD: collectible counter and health petals.

genres.name: Psychological horror
genres.image_scene: A trembling hand holds a lantern in a candle-lit stone cellar, a shadowy figure at the end of a warped corridor. No HUD beyond a subtle fear vignette.

genres.name: Sim racer
genres.image_scene: Cockpit view in a GT race car at dusk at the apex of a corner, wet track reflections and a rival in the mirrors. HUD: speed, gear, tyre temperatures, lap delta.

genres.name: Metroidvania
systems: Melee and ranged combat with hitboxes and hurtboxes
genres.image_scene: A cloaked wanderer with a slender blade stands in a vast cavern of glowing fungi and ancient ruins, an ability-locked gate ahead and a winged enemy swooping in. HUD: health pips, energy orb, small map in the corner.

genres.name: Tycoon
genres.image_scene: A busy theme park with a looping coaster, food stalls and guests with thought bubbles. HUD: cash, park rating, guest count, build menu.

genres.name: Physics sandbox
systems: Rigid bodies with joints and constraints
genres.image_scene: A wobbly ragdoll character dangles from a crane they built from beams and wheels in a test map, props flying. HUD: tool menu and spawn list.

genres.name: 3D fighting
systems: Frame data with counters and throws
genres.image_scene: Two fighters clash in a ruined temple courtyard, one mid-sidestep with motion trails, torches and drifting petals, low cinematic camera. HUD: health bars, round counter and timer.

genres.name: Note-highway rhythm
genres.image_scene: A scrolling note highway of coloured gems in front of a guitarist performing on a festival stage. HUD: score multiplier and performance meter.

genres.name: Cover shooter
genres.image_scene: An armoured soldier pressed against a low concrete wall blind-fires at enemies across a ruined plaza, sparks bursting on the cover. HUD: crosshair, ammo with reload bar, cover prompt.

genres.name: Base-building RTS
genres.image_scene: A military base with refinery, power plants and barracks, harvesters collecting ore and tanks massing to attack an enemy base across a river. HUD: build sidebar, credits, power meter, minimap.

genres.name: Top-down action-adventure
reference_games_mechanics_only: The Legend of Zelda: A Link to the Past
systems: Dungeon keys, switches and block puzzles
genres.image_scene: A young adventurer with sword and shield in a stone dungeon room, a pushable block puzzle, a locked door with a keyhole and slime enemies. HUD: hearts, item slots, key and gem counts.

genres.name: Flight
systems: Missiles and radar, or landing and navigation
genres.image_scene: A jet fighter banks over a sea of clouds at sunset, a missile contrail curving toward an enemy jet inside a lock box. HUD: altitude, speed, missile count, radar.

genres.name: Fishing
genres.image_scene: An angler on a misty lake at dawn fights a fish on the line, the water splashing. HUD: line tension meter, reel speed, fish depth.

genres.name: Job simulator
systems: Tool interactions on paintable surface masks
genres.image_scene: First-person view pressure-washing a mossy patio, clean stripes revealing bright stone. HUD: percentage clean and nozzle selector.

genres.name: Character action
systems: Dodge with invincibility frames and a slow-motion reward
genres.image_scene: A stylish swordsman in a long coat performs an aerial combo against winged demons in a gothic cathedral, glowing sword arcs and a slow-motion dodge ripple. HUD: style rank letter, health and power gauge.

genres.name: Tactics RPG
genres.image_scene: A grid battlefield on a ruined castle bridge, blue movement tiles around a knight, an archer aiming from higher ground. HUD: unit stats panel and hit-chance preview.

genres.name: Space exploration
genres.image_scene: View from a ship cockpit descending through clouds toward an alien planet of strange flora and floating rocks. HUD: scanner, altitude, ship status.

genres.name: Colony sim
genres.image_scene: A small frontier colony with stockpile zones and colonists at work, a raid approaching from the map edge. HUD: colonist bar, alerts, time controls, resources.

genres.name: Factory automation
systems: Conveyor and inserter simulation at scale
genres.image_scene: A sprawling factory of conveyor belts, assembly machines and robotic arms moving items between power poles. HUD: production rates, research progress, hotbar.

genres.name: Speed platformer
systems: Momentum physics on slopes, loops and quarter-pipes
genres.image_scene: A lean armadillo courier in orange sneakers blurs through a loop on a coastal clifftop track, speed streaks behind, spring pads and glittering gems along a rolling hillside. HUD: gem count and act timer.

genres.name: Puzzle platformer
systems: Platformer controller with push, pull and carry
genres.image_scene: A lone small figure pushes a wooden crate toward a pressure plate in a misty industrial ruin, a heavy door waiting to rise, foreground pipes in silhouette and deep atmospheric haze. Little or no HUD.

genres.name: Squad tactics
genres.image_scene: Four soldiers take cover in a ruined farmhouse while alien enemies advance across a field, hit percentages and overwatch icons shown. HUD: action points and ability bar.

genres.name: Competitive RTS
genres.image_scene: Human and alien armies clash on a rocky highland while worker units mine glowing crystals, psionic blasts lighting the battle. HUD: command card, minimap, supply count, resource counters.

genres.name: Naval combat
genres.image_scene: A battleship fires a broadside on a stormy sea, shell arcs and splashes around an enemy ship on the horizon. HUD: aim lead markers, reload dials, minimap.

genres.name: Brick breaker
genres.image_scene: A neon brick wall shatters as several glowing balls bounce off a paddle and power-up capsules fall. HUD: score, lives, level.

genres.name: Maze chase
systems: Chaser AI personalities with chase and scatter modes
genres.image_scene: A round blob hero races through a neon maze dotted with pellets, chased by spirits of different shapes and colours. HUD: score and lives.

genres.name: Cinematic choice adventure
genres.image_scene: Two characters in a tense conversation in a rain-soaked diner, timed dialogue choices floating around the frame.

genres.name: Logic puzzle
genres.image_scene: A tiny protagonist in a grid puzzle room of pushable crates and glowing goal tiles. HUD: move count and undo hint.

genres.name: Twin-stick shooter
systems: Dual-axis aim with mouse or right stick
genres.image_scene: A tiny ship fires neon bullets in every direction inside a glowing grid arena while swarms of geometric enemies explode into particles. HUD: score, multiplier, lives.

genres.name: Stealth action
systems: Guard AI states (patrol, suspicious, alert, search)
genres.image_scene: An operative crouches in shadow behind crates in a lamp-lit warehouse, a guard's vision cone sweeping nearby, a noise ripple from a thrown bottle. HUD: alert indicator, noise meter, equipped gadget.

genres.name: Skate and extreme sports
genres.image_scene: A skater grinds a rail in a sunny skate park, combo text popping, ramps and painted walls around. HUD: trick combo and multiplier, score, timer.

genres.name: Grand strategy
genres.image_scene: A political map of a continent split into provinces in nation colours, armies stacked on the borders and an event pop-up window. HUD: date and speed controls, treasury, diplomacy panel.

genres.name: First-person puzzle
genres.image_scene: A clean white test chamber where a laser beam is redirected by a cube onto a receiver beside a glowing button. HUD: minimal crosshair.

genres.name: Rally and off-road
genres.image_scene: A rally car slides through a muddy forest stage, mud spraying, spectators behind tape. HUD: stage time, pace-note arrows, damage indicator.

genres.name: Tennis and racket sports
genres.image_scene: Broadcast view of a clay-court rally, a player stretching for a sliced backhand, the ball leaving a trail and the stands full. HUD: scoreboard and shot-type indicator.

genres.name: Space trading sim
genres.image_scene: Cockpit view approaching the docking slot of a rotating space station, freighters nearby and a planet below. HUD: radar, docking prompt, cargo and credits.

genres.name: Beat 'em up
systems: Crowd AI that takes turns attacking
genres.image_scene: Three street brawlers fight a crowd of punk thugs on a neon-lit city street at night, one mid-uppercut with an impact spark, a dropped lead pipe on the ground. HUD: player portraits with health bars and a combo counter.

genres.name: Boxing and combat sports
genres.image_scene: Two boxers trade punches under bright ring lights, sweat spraying on impact, the referee watching. HUD: health and stamina bars, round timer.

genres.name: Arena FPS
genres.image_scene: First-person view with a glowing plasma rifle in a sci-fi arena of jump pads and floating platforms, an opponent rocket-jumping mid-air, a power-up spinning on a pedestal. HUD: health, armour, ammo, frag count.

genres.name: Interactive fiction
genres.image_scene: A beautifully typeset page of text with an illustrated map and a list of choices on parchment, small inventory icons in the margin.

genres.name: Mech combat
systems: Modular part loadouts affecting weight and heat
genres.image_scene: A heavy bipedal mech boosts across a desert battlefield, missiles launching from shoulder pods, heat shimmer around the thrusters. HUD: heat gauge, armour by part, weapon-group ammo.

genres.name: Run and gun
systems: Enemy waves triggered by scroll position
genres.image_scene: Two commandos in mismatched armour sprint through a jungle outpost firing spread shots at a walking tank boss, explosions and shell casings everywhere. HUD: scores, lives and weapon icons for each player.

genres.name: Walking sim
genres.image_scene: View from a fire lookout tower over a golden forest at sunset, a walkie-talkie in hand and a handwritten note on the desk. No HUD.

genres.name: Boomer shooter
systems: Camera-facing sprite enemies with 8 facing angles
genres.image_scene: First-person view with a double-barrel shotgun in a hellish techbase corridor, sprite demons charging, a blue keycard door ahead, bright muzzle flash. HUD bar along the bottom with health, ammo and keys.

genres.name: Vehicular combat
genres.image_scene: Armoured cars with roof-mounted weapons battle in an abandoned stadium, a missile streaking between them and explosions. HUD: health, weapon selector, special ammo, minimap.

genres.name: Point-and-click adventure
genres.image_scene: A hand-painted seaside town of crooked houses, the hero chatting with a merchant on the docks. HUD: verb bar and inventory along the bottom.

genres.name: Real-time tactics
genres.image_scene: Infantry squads advance through a bombed village under machine-gun suppression fire, a half-collapsed church and drifting smoke. HUD: unit cards, command buttons, minimap.

genres.name: Artillery
genres.image_scene: A cratered island with two teams of tiny soldiers, one aiming a bazooka with a wind indicator, explosions tearing chunks out of the terrain. HUD: wind meter, turn timer, team health totals.

genres.name: Classic arcade shooter
genres.image_scene: A small ship in a dark playfield blasts drifting rocks into fragments, a saucer in the corner. HUD: score and lives icons.

genres.name: Shoot 'em up
genres.image_scene: A sleek fighter ship weaves through dense spiral bullet patterns fired by a giant mechanical boss above a space station, power-up orbs drifting. HUD: score, bombs, power level.

genres.name: Immersive sim
genres.image_scene: An agent with a mechanical arm hacks a door panel in a rainy industrial city alley while a guard patrols above. HUD: health, energy, ability wheel.

genres.name: Space dogfighting
genres.image_scene: Cockpit view of a starfighter in a dogfight near a capital ship, an enemy fighter with a lead indicator, shield shimmer and a nebula backdrop. HUD: shield, engine and weapon power pips, target box.

genres.name: Top-down racer
genres.image_scene: Tiny toy cars race across a breakfast-table track lined with cereal bowls and spoons, skid marks and a boost pickup. HUD: position, lap and player colours.

genres.name: Rhythm action
systems: Beat clock driving movement and attacks
genres.image_scene: A dungeon floor pulsing to the beat, a hero attacking a skeleton exactly on the beat, beat markers along the bottom. HUD: hearts, beat bar, coin multiplier.

genres.name: Dungeon crawler
genres.image_scene: Looking down a stone dungeon corridor at a skeleton warrior, a pressure plate on the floor and torch sconces on the walls. HUD: four party portraits with health and an auto-map in the corner.

genres.name: Pinball
systems: Continuous collision for the fast ball
genres.image_scene: A space-themed pinball table with lit bumpers and ramps, the ball mid-flight. HUD: dot-matrix style score display.

genres.name: Turn-based wargame
genres.image_scene: A tile map with cute infantry, tanks and artillery on grass, mountains and cities, a blue movement range highlighted. HUD: unit info, terrain defence stars, day counter.

genres.name: Rail shooter
genres.image_scene: A starfighter flies through a canyon with a lock-on reticle on incoming drones and laser fire streaking forward. HUD: shield bar, hit counter, bomb count.

genres.name: Classic roguelike
systems: Field of view and map memory
genres.image_scene: A procedurally generated dungeon of tiles with the hero's lit field of view, unexplored areas in darkness, monsters and items as symbols. HUD: message log and stats panel.

genres.name: Anti-gravity racer
systems: Track-relative gravity through loops and tubes
